critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~4877 lines (grew ~260 lines this iter). Repeated note from iter-11/12/13: split into routers (badges, forecast, yir_attribution, waitlist) — maintenance is becoming painful.

_program_forecast computes days_to_fill as round(left/(rate/7)); when rate < 1 but > 0 and left is small, projection can round to 0 and incorrectly trigger flag=true via 'days<=14'. Low impact (short-rate programs still legitimately need another session) but mention days_to_fill may read '0' pre-fill. Consider clamping to >=1 when seats remaining.

_waitlist_join_alert and _send_forecast silently return on failure (no retries, no sentinel row). If email provider is down, admins see no alert. Consider queueing failures in db.scheduled_runs or exposing a 'last error' field.

yir_email_click swallows HTTPException from _rate_limit (good UX — still redirects), but silent rate-limit means admins viewing results may undercount legit clicks when a staffer tests the link rapidly. Consider separating click telemetry from attack mitigation.

DonationCheckout.source regex ^yir-(email|page)-\d{4}$ is strict (good). Future sources (e.g. appeal campaigns, 'homepage-hero') will silently become null — refactor to a configurable allowlist when more campaigns are added.
Admin > Reports > Program fill forecast table on narrow viewport (<=768px) overflows; the parent uses overflow-x:auto so it scrolls, but 'Last 4 weeks' sparkline column cramps on mobile. Minor UX.

ShareBar is exported from YearInReview.jsx but reused on BadgePage.jsx — the module coupling is awkward (BadgePage imports a page component just for ShareBar). Move ShareBar to /components/ShareBar.jsx.
